attributes.board_name: Mississippi State Board of Physical Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 15 CCUs from Certified Activities: courses meeting FSBPT Standards of Continuing Competence; APTA, MPTA and other APTA chapter/section courses; university-approved programs; Board-approved programs; academic coursework (graduate level for PTs, undergraduate acceptable for PTAs; 11 CCUs per semester credit hour, grade C or better); APTA-credentialed residency/fellowship; exams and assessments (ABPTS certification, PTA advanced proficiency, FSBPT Practice Review Tool; min 15 CCUs). Approved Activities max 15 CCUs: other courses (2 CCUs for 1-7 contact hours, 5 CCUs for 8-31, 10 CCUs for >32), clinical instructorship (1 CCU per 40 h, max 6), board/committee work, structured interactive study, etc. Online courses accepted. Staff meetings and lay presentations are not accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial licensure within a licensing period: CC hours are prorated; the Board notifies the required hours at licensure.
rules.audit_note: Random audit each licensure period, shown on the online renewal payment screen; CE Broker data is used to verify. Missing hours lead to a probationary license for one period.

topics.who: All licensees: 3 hours of Board-approved study in ethics, professionalism or jurisprudence per licensing period; part of the 30 CCUs

rules.legal_basis: Miss. Admin. Code Part 3103, Chapter 5 (Rules 5.1-5.6); Miss. Code Ann. §73-23-43
rules.notes: Two-year licensing period July 1 - June 30; renewal years alternate by surname (A-L odd years, M-Z even years). At least 25% (7.5 CCU) must relate directly to clinical PT practice. The Board counts in CCUs; credit from certified courses is applied as awarded, and the Board's page states the ethics requirement as 3 hours. Rule 5.5 text still names FSBPT aPTitude for reporting, but the Board's page and 2026 renewal notice require CE Broker. Renewal fee $150 PT, $125 PTA.
rules.rule_quote: 1. Regulations set the requirement of 30 continuing competence units (CCU) to be accrued during each 2 year licensing period (July 1 - June 30).
